sloka: उत्पपाताथ वेगेन वेगवानविचारयन् ।सुपर्णमिव चात्मानं मेने स कपिकुञ्जरः ॥५-१-४४॥
transliteration: utpapātātha vegena vegavānavicārayan ।suparṇamiva cātmānaṁ mene sa kapikuñjaraḥ ॥5-1-44॥

translations.english: Having thus addressed the monkeys the foremost of vanaras,Hanuman endowed with great speed leaped without any exertion. The elephant among monkeys felt like Garuda.
